captions.caption: A person uses a stick to lift a glowing red crucible from a fire.
The crucible is moved carefully across a rocky ground.
The crucible is placed into a small depression among rocks.
A wooden stick is inserted into the molten material inside the crucible.
The stick is used to stir the glowing liquid inside the hot vessel.
Close-up of the bright orange interior of the cooling crucible.
The stick is removed, leaving the glowing crucible to cool.
The intense heat causes the interior of the crucible to glow brightly.
Smoke and heat waves rise from the recently fired crucible.
The crucible sits among grey rocks as its orange glow persists.
The light from the crucible begins to dim as it loses heat.
The camera cuts to a view of the cooled, solidified crucible.
A hand reaches out to touch the rough surface of the cooled crucible.
A person holds a dark, porous piece of slag rock in their hand.
The hand rotates the slag rock to inspect its various surfaces.
Close-up of the rough, bubbly texture of the dark slag.
The person turns the slag over, revealing some shiny metallic spots.
Sunlight reflects off small metallic inclusions within the dark rock.
The hand holds the slag rock steady against a sandy background.
A finger points to a specific area on the irregular slag rock.
The camera focuses on a tiny, shiny bead of metal on the rock.
A person's thumb is used to indicate the size of a metallic bead.
Close-up of a finger touching a small, silver-colored metallic bead.
The person uses a fingernail to try and pry a bead loose.
Two fingers hold the slag rock while inspecting its metallic contents.
A finger presses against a small metallic inclusion in the rock.
The person examines the rock closely for more metallic pieces.
A small stone or tool is used to scrape at the surface of the slag.
The tool successfully dislodges a tiny piece of metal from the rock.
The person points to the small indentation left by the removed metal.
A hand holds a small, irregular metallic bead between two fingers.
Close-up of the small metallic bead held against the person's palm.
The person drops the small metallic bead into a clay bowl.
Several small metallic beads are already sitting in the bottom of the bowl.
Another metallic bead is dropped into the container by hand.
The person uses a small white stone to scrape more metal from the slag.
Close-up of the white stone tool prying at a metallic bead.
The tool works to loosen a small, shiny piece of metal.
The person picks up the newly extracted metallic bead.
A hand shows the extracted metallic bead to the camera.
The person drops the latest bead into the clay bowl.
Inside the bowl, several small metallic beads are visible.
A finger moves the beads around the bottom of the bowl.
The person continues the process of extracting metal from the slag.
The stone tool is used to dislodge another small metallic inclusion.
A finger picks up the small piece of metal from the rock surface.
The person holds the small metallic bead up for inspection.
The bead is dropped into the bowl with the others.
The camera pans slightly over the collection of metallic beads.
Close-up of several small, shiny metallic beads in the bowl.
The person tilts the bowl to show the beads moving inside.
A finger touches one of the beads at the bottom of the bowl.
The bowl is held steady, showing the result of the extraction.
A wide shot shows the bowl, slag rock, and crucible on the ground.
The camera pans across the three objects used in the process.
A close-up view of the porous slag rock is shown.
The camera shifts focus to the crucible on the right.
The camera pans back to the small clay bowl on the left.
All three components are shown together in a single frame.
The three metallurgical items sit still on the ground as the scene ends.
